description:
Report how each field, input field, and enum value in a variant's schema has been used since a given time, and whether it is deprecated, as compact CSV.
Columns: coordinate kind, named type, named attribute, used, deprecated, referencing operation count, observed execution count, estimated execution count, last seen at, plus client name and client version when `groupByClient` is true.
Pass `deprecated: true` and `used: true` to find deprecated fields that clients still use, and add `groupByClient: true` to see which client name and version uses each one.
Pass `used: false` to find coordinates that nothing has referenced since `since`. Enum values and input object fields are counted only when the router enables extended reference reporting, because the router has to inspect argument and variable values to see them. Without it, they come back as unused even when clients use them, so also pass `coordinateKinds: [OBJECT_FIELD]`.
Each row covers the whole window since `since`, which must be within the last 90 days.
`used: false` means not referenced since `since`, not never used.
Usage comes from the operation metrics that the variant's router or server reports to GraphOS.
Execution counts for enum values and input object fields are always zero.
`clients` keeps the coordinates used by at least one of up to 100 client name and version pairs; omit `clientVersion` to match every version of that client, and use GetClientMetrics to discover the names a graph sees.
Rows are ranked by `orderBy` descending: default REFERENCING_OPERATION_COUNT; LAST_SEEN_AT for the most recently seen.
The report has no paging, so a row count equal to `limit` means rows may have been cut off; raise `limit` (at most 100000) and run it again.
Provide the graph ID, the variant name, and `since`.

SchemaCoordinateInsightsUsageReportClien.description: A client filter entry. At least one of clientName or clientVersion must be provided. Omitting clientVersion matches all versions of the given client; omitting clientName matches all clients with the given version.

clientName.description: The client name. If omitted, matches any client name.

clientVersion.description: The client version. If omitted, matches any client version.

SchemaCoordinateInsightsUsageReportColum.description:
A sortable column of the schema coordinate usage report.

Values:
ESTIMATED_EXECUTION_COUNT: The estimated total number of times that the coordinate was executed taking into account sampling. This will always be zero for input object fields and enum values.
LAST_SEEN_AT: The timestamp that the coordinate was last executed or referenced.
OBSERVED_EXECUTION_COUNT: The number of times that the coordinate was reported as executed. This will always be zero for input object fields and enum values.
REFERENCING_OPERATION_COUNT: The number of operation executions that contained a reference to the coordinate.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601, extended format with nanoseconds, Zulu (or "[+-]seconds" as a string or number relative to now)

groupByClient.description:
When false (default), each row represents a single schema coordinate aggregated across all clients.
When true, each row represents a single (coordinate, client name, client version) combination with per-client metrics.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 1000, max 100000).

since.description: The lower bound of the usage window. A schema coordinate is reported as 'used' if it was referenced or executed at any point at or after this timestamp. Must be within the last 90 days and in the format: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z (ISO 8601).

name: GetFieldUsage
